address: Trg fra Andrije Kačića Miošića 5, Makarska, 21300, Croatia
bio: This small and welcoming tavern, rustic in character yet modern in spirit, is run by the couple Ela Ožić and Ljudevit Blažević. Their cooking is founded on seasonal ingredients and carefully selected produce of notable freshness and quality. Dalmatian tradition is fused with interesting Italian influences, giving rise to dishes of considerable character, prepared to order and always thoughtfully presented. At lunch the menu is more concise, focused on generous portions and satisfying flavours, while in the evening the offering expands to include more refined creations.
